Penalità di Prestazione

A reduction in aircraft performance, such as climb, takeoff, or landing, resulting from inoperative systems or configuration deviations.

Questions and answers

What is Penalità di Prestazione?

In this glossary, Penalità di Prestazione refers to: A reduction in aircraft performance, such as climb, takeoff, or landing, resulting from inoperative systems or configuration deviations.

How is Penalità di Prestazione used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Si applica una penalità di prestazione se il sistema anti-ghiaccio è inattivo al decollo."

Definition

A reduction in aircraft performance, such as climb, takeoff, or landing, resulting from inoperative systems or configuration deviations.

Operational example

A Performance Penalty applies if the anti-ice system is inoperative during takeoff.
